notes: 22 candidates: 2 program-list, 0 single-record, 20 not-a-list. The two program-list pages are the EPFL TRANSP-OR (Transport and Mobility Laboratory, Prof. Michel Bierlaire, ENAC) PhD graduates and PhD theses pages; they cover the same 25 doctoral graduates (2003-2018) with 'last known affiliation', which is a current/later affiliation as of the 2019 capture, not necessarily the first job (e.g. Carolina Osorio listed as MIT professor, Emma Frejinger as Université de Montréal professor, Flurin Hänseler as TU Delft postdoc). It is an operations-research/transportation lab in the civil-engineering school, not a business school; classify the area accordingly. The twelve commons.wmu.se pages are WMU Digital Commons dissertation collections for MSc in Maritime Affairs specializations (Shipping Management & Logistics, Port Management, Maritime Education & Training, etc.); the pages do not state the degree level, but the volume (dozens per year back to 1987) and the specialization names match WMU's master's programme, and WMU's doctoral theses are a separate collection not in this batch, so they were marked not-a-list; an integrator who wants them as master's-level data can reverse that. The remaining EPFL lab pages (soil mechanics, urban sociology, nanoelectronics, telecom circuits, architecture archives) do list PhD theses with authors but belong to departments outside operations/management. No institution-by-host corrections.
